The scared part keeps asking, what if I can't manage? Last night I got tired of both and made a list instead. Find a room near the office, ask Uncle Rao about the first week, save the number for the landlord, pack the winter jacket. Then I emailed my new manager to ask what the first day looks like. She wrote back kindly within the hour. I still feel the dread, but now it has steps.

Come visit when I've a sofa.

Amandeep

"The internship. Yes." Ganga couldn't stop smiling.
"That's huge. Tell me everything."
"It's mostly luck, honestly. And you helped me practise the case question four times."

"So don't post the news all over. Tell your family, tell the people who helped, and be kind about your cousin."
"I called Grandma first. She cried."
